title: Region-Guided Food-Package Evidence Extraction and Abstention-Aware Draft R3337 Screening with Selective VLM Review
abstract: arXiv:2610.28211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Applying South Africa's draft R3337 warning criteria to food-package photographs requires nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. This study presents a region-guided evidence extraction and abstention-aware screening workflow for draft R3337. A three-class detector localises nutrition information panels, ingredient lists and product-identity regions, after which PaddleOCR and structured extraction recover nutrient values, ingredient evidence and product-form information. Recovered evidence is aggregated and assessed using deterministic draft R3337 rules. When evidence is incomplete, uncertain or conflicting, the workflow abstains through Review or Insufficient evidence rather than forcing an automatic outcome. For qualifying unresolved cases, a selective vision-language model (VLM) review stage using Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct reassesses unresolved evidence. Accepted evidence is merged and the same deterministic rules are reapplied.

translated_title: 基于区域引导的食品包装证据提取与弃权感知的R3337草案筛查及选择性视觉语言模型复核
translated_abstract: 将南非R3337草案警示标准应用于食品包装照片需要营养成分、配料及产品形态方面的证据。本研究提出了一种针对R3337草案的区域引导证据提取与弃权感知筛查工作流程。首先由一个三类检测器定位营养成分信息面板、配料表和产品标识区域，随后使用PaddleOCR和结构化提取来获取营养素数值、配料证据和产品形态信息。所恢复的证据被聚合后，依据确定性的R3337草案规则进行评估。当证据不完整、不确定或相互冲突时，该工作流程会通过“待复核”或“证据不足”进行弃权，而不是强行给出自动判定结果。对于符合条件的未决案例，一个选择性的视觉语言模型（VLM）复核阶段会使用Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct对未决证据进行重新评估。被接受的证据将被合并，并重新应用相同的确定性规则。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种区域引导、弃权感知的筛查工作流程，将三类目标检测、OCR结构化提取、确定性R3337草案规则评估与选择性视觉语言模型复核相结合，用于从食品包装照片中筛查南非R3337草案警示标准，并在证据不完整或冲突时弃权而非强行判定。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a region-guided, abstention-aware screening workflow that combines three-class detection, OCR-based structured extraction, deterministic draft R3337 rules, and selective VLM review (Qwen3-VL 8B) to assess food-package photographs against South Africa's draft R3337 warning criteria, abstaining when evidence is incomplete, uncertain, or conflicting.
